The Studio

Who we are

Welcome to Jax Nation.

We are a multidisciplinary creative production company built around one simple idea: to create work that people don't just see, but feel.

From film and advertising to dance, choreography, drawing and painting, we bring different creative disciplines together to transform ideas, stories and emotions into experiences.

Three creative worlds. One Jax Nation.

Different tools. Same purpose.

06 / Studio

One call. Everything covered.

Jax Nation Productions brings film production and live performance together under one company. That means one point of contact for a shoot, an event or a full stage show, not three vendors who have never worked together. We handle the concept, the crew, the cameras and the stage, and we hold the same standard across all of it. If it needs to be filmed, staged, or both, we're built to be the only call you make.

The space

Team Jax Nation Dance & Production Studio

A first-floor studio on The Wicker in Sheffield, with a mirrored wall, a wide open floor and original wood panelling under a decorative ceiling. It is the home of Team Jax Nation and The Groove Cartel, and it is available to hire for rehearsals, shoots and sessions.

Sadacca, 1st Floor 48 The Wicker Sheffield, S3 8JB

Settings
The passcode is a light lock to keep casual visitors out of this screen. It's stored in the page itself, so treat it as a doorbell, not a vault. The real protection is that only your own signed-in Claude account can actually publish changes to this site. Someone without your account can open this screen and even guess the passcode, but their save attempt will still be turned away. There's no visible link to this screen anywhere on the site, so it won't get crawled or found by browsing around. To get back in, click anywhere on the page first, then press Ctrl+Alt+A (Cmd+Option+A on a Mac).
